description: Manage the caller's tracked job applications on OpenVibe.Work: list (GET /api/v1/me/applications), add from a listing or by hand (POST), read with its status history, edit status, notes, dates and next step (PATCH), and delete (DELETE). A person acting for themself needs no capability; an app or agent token needs this one. Asking the person's OpenVibe.Actor agent (POST …/assist) is the person's own act and takes no capability.
